_comment: Minimum safe versions for dependencies with known critical CVEs. Update when new advisories drop. Only direct dependencies in package.json are checked (see scripts/version-floor-check.sh) — floors for packages we do not depend on directly can never fire.

next.reason: CVE-2025-66478 (RCE), CVE-2025-29927 (auth bypass), CVE-2025-55184 (DoS), CVE-2026-23864 (DoS). Also covers the React Server Components RCE (CVE-2025-55182, CVSS 10.0): the react-server-dom-* runtime ships inside next, so it is not a direct dependency and must be enforced through the next floor.
